source_snapshot.procedure: Generic setup says clear logs; open Dashboard and Server Health > Sensor Reading.
source_snapshot.criteria: Sensor reading and threshold are human readable and match specification.
source_snapshot.deepseek: YES treats RTM1~8 as one literal sensor and truncates fallback inventory; it omits RTM semantics, eight physical device/PCIe-path/BMC-field identities and complete UI/spec evidence.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION requires eight separate records but leaves RTM open as a generic module/zone instead of proving the likely PCIe retimer devices.

old_problem: One literal range query could be reported as eight temperatures without defining RTM or binding each record to a physical retimer-class device, stable PCIe route and BMC field. Arbitrary GPU indices, BDF enumeration, generic module telemetry or one RTM could be substituted, while link operations might be added without source authority.
disposition_reason: Confirm GB/RTM terminology, then resolve RTM1 through RTM8 independently and bind each to the physical retimer or Project-defined component, part/firmware/reference designator, upstream/downstream PCIe path and BMC controller/bus/mux/address temperature field. Compare complete OOB/two-UI evidence with per-device limits under the existing passive link/load/cooling state.
decision_basis: XLSX row 889, same-row DeepSeek, exact GPT V2, internal Script reference, selection manifest, related source cases and historical record were directly reviewed.
Tilde shorthand is not proven IPMI syntax and one response cannot satisfy eight independently identified devices.
In this GPU-baseboard context RTM plausibly denotes PCIe retimers, but Project confirmation and schematic/topology mapping are mandatory; numeric RTM, GPU and BDF indices are not inherently aligned.
ED-15 requires per-device limits, ED-17 preserves AER/XID/thermal logs, ED-20 preserves all eight identities and ED-14 keeps dynamic threshold and PCIe behavior separate.

test_case.test_name: Verify GPU-baseboard RTM1 through RTM8 temperatures independently by device, PCIe path and BMC source
test_case.purpose: After confirming GB/RTM terminology, verify eight temperature records are separately human readable in Dashboard and Server Health, map to the correct physical retimer-class devices and BMC fields on the exact baseboard revision, and independently meet applicable value, units, health, threshold/hysteresis and freshness specifications under recorded passive PCIe/link/load/cooling state.
required_package: Project confirmation of GB/RTM terminology and exact chassis/GPU-baseboard PN/revision plus BMC/BIOS
Per-index physical device location, part/revision/serial/firmware and board reference designator
Per-device upstream/root/switch and downstream GPU endpoint PCIe topology with stable BDF identities
Per-device BMC controller/bus/mux/address path and exact die or board temperature field
Separate stable SDR/API and Dashboard/Server Health identities for RTM1 through RTM8
Per-device units/scaling, approved range/delta, threshold capability/values/hysteresis, health, freshness and variant rules
Recorded host/GPU power/load, PCIe link speed/width/state, fan speeds and baseboard airflow
Validated protected OOB/API/browser clients and pinned immutable reviewed `sensor.git` revision/checksum or approved manual read-only method
test_case.test_command: Do not clear SEL/kernel/AER/GPU XID/PCIe/thermal logs, generate traffic, retrain/reset links, change link speed/power, service hardware, alter fans/airflow/thresholds or update firmware. Confirm RTM semantics and build an eight-row device/part/firmware/PCIe-path/BMC-source matrix. Enumerate the complete BMC repository and resolve RTM1 through RTM8 separately; do not use `TEMP_GB_RTM1~8` as one record unless explicitly documented. Review the Script before use. Capture per device its independent query status, stable identity, value, units, capability/threshold/hysteresis, health and timestamp plus matching Dashboard and Server Health rows. Record existing link/load/cooling state without changing it. Stop without retry on missing, duplicate, swapped, stale or divergent rows.
test_case.expected_result: Eight independently dispositioned records and UI rows map to the correct physical retimer-class devices, PCIe paths and documented BMC fields for the installed baseboard. Each applicable row matches its value/unit/threshold/status/freshness specification under the recorded passive state. GPU temperature, link status or arbitrary enumeration never substitutes, and PCIe/hardware state remains unchanged.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires authoritative RTM semantics and separate complete OOB/two-UI/spec agreement for every applicable RTM1-8 row with device/path/source proof and engineer verdict. One literal range query, one device, GPU/BDF index assumption, link status, label-only match or truncated output cannot pass. Missing/swapped/duplicate/stale identity, unjustified N/A, out-of-limit value or required threshold/status mismatch is FAIL. Missing topology/source/spec/reviewed method is NOT READY, not Pending or PASS; signal integrity, traffic, retraining, reset and firmware are outside scope.
safety_gate: Do not clear SEL, kernel/AER, GPU XID, PCIe or thermal logs; retimer/link history is relevant evidence.
Do not interpret the range as one record or accept fewer than eight independently dispositioned rows.
Do not infer RTM-to-GPU/BDF mapping numerically; bind each physical device through the approved schematic/topology.
Do not replace a BMC field with host PCIe inventory or link status; exact management-source and field identity are required.
Do not generate traffic, retrain/reset links, change speed/power, service hardware, alter cooling/thresholds or flash firmware.
Do not truncate output, expose credentials or run an unreviewed Script; no automatic retry.
expected_evidence: Chassis/GPU-baseboard PN/revision, BMC/BIOS, RTM definition and eight-row physical device, part/firmware/reference-designator and PCIe-path matrix
Per-RTM BMC controller/bus/mux/address and exact temperature-field source
Eight separate complete raw identities, values, units, threshold capabilities/values, health and timestamps plus separate Dashboard and Server Health rows
Recorded PCIe topology/link speed/width/state, host/GPU load, fan/baseboard airflow and per-device specification/tolerance/update-lag comparison
Missing/duplicate/swapped/stale/divergent disposition and pinned Script or alternate-method audit
No-clear/no-traffic/no-retrain-or-reset/no-service/no-retry proof, final PCIe/GPU/BMC health and eight-device engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: No mutation is expected. On terminology, device, PCIe-path or management-field ambiguity, stale/divergent values or unexpected PCIe/GPU/BMC health change, stop and preserve all first-pass evidence plus link/topology state. Use approved read-only BMC/PCIe diagnostics; do not retrain, reset or service devices to force evidence. Any independently authorized PCIe action requires its own recovery plan.

source_conflict.reason: RTM and topology need Project confirmation, but Items, UI Procedure and Criteria consistently request passive display/spec validation of eight temperatures.

blocked.reason: The eight-record passive intent is identifiable. RTM semantics, device/path/source map and per-device acceptance are supplyable Project inputs.

external_authorities.application: Use only after immutable pinning and safety review; it cannot define RTM devices, PCIe paths or BMC temperature fields.
